assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The service is ordered to evaluate for arrhythmia or ischemic evaluation that is medically necessary for the patient's recurrent dizziness
Prior approval was required for this diagnostic procedure
Prior approval was not obtained before service
The CO-197 denial is being appealed
